correctness.rationale: Global density positivity iff piecewise parameter inequalities is proved using the exact attainable interval 2z<=s²+t²<=1+z² and one-variable quadratic minimization. Fourier orthogonality gives the exact conditional rank coefficient, its sharp maximum, zero rho/tau, and the two nontrivial transition eigenvalues. Symbolic checker passes. Finite probes are not relied on for universality.

value.rationale: Replaces a deliberately conservative sufficient inference domain by a sharp nonlinear, globally attainable copula-validity phase diagram. Gives exact extremal nonlinear predictability and maximal operator correlation hidden to both standard rank concordance coefficients; these are natural within-family bounds and distinct optimizer designs, not routine single-parameter substitutions.
